Remark
[Lie and covariant derivatives of the Hessian operator]

Source: petersen:page-0121 ↗ def:pet-ch3-hessian-square-notation ↗ thm:pet-ch3-radial-curvature-equation

1. ch3:3.4.3For $f$ with $S(X)= abla _X abla f$, show that $\mathcal L_{ abla f}S= abla _{ abla f}S$ and $(\mathcal L_{ abla f}S)(X)+S^2(X)- abla _X(S( abla f))=-R_{ abla f}(X)$. Reconcile this with item 3 for the $(0,2)$-version of the Hessian.
